shortDescription: The Bank of Korea called for tighter monitoring of overseas derivatives tied to Korean chipmakers, warning that their rapid growth could amplify swings in the domestic market, according to Bloomberg.It cited leveraged bets by hedge fund Situational Awareness as a driver of recent volatility.
